inputs.original_text: I can't believe they're pushing this narrative of strong disappointment over the US withdrawing from the Paris Agreement for the second time under Donald Trump, even dragging in how China and the United States supposedly consolidated unity to lay the foundation for it. Their so-called disappointment just proves the withdrawal is disrupting the secret agenda they had in place.
